rationale: Adds a compact late-phase training-loss curriculum that increasingly upweights the final eval-aligned token positions while preserving the current recurrent-tail/quant-aware path. This spends more of the 600s budget on the exact stride region that drives final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb, avoids another exhausted scalar sweep, and reuses a single forward pass for base, masked, and training losses to stay lean.
title: Late Tail-Aligned Loss Curriculum
